description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape patient care standards, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure the highest quality of service delivery. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of nursing operations, including staff management, patient care planning, and adherence to all state and federal guidelines. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing nursing policies and procedures, ensuring a safe and effective care environment for all residents. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for a candidate ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of progressive nursing leadership experience, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations and survey processes.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing nursing team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
